method.controls: Unmodified source highlights, unchanged/equivalent repeated values, different year, cohort, denominator, unit and citation, quotation, approximation, ranges and repetitions within a single paragraph. Also recount archived genuine journal, forum, USWDS versions, and genuine originals matching AI-edit banks.
method.evaluation: All scenarios and source rules fixed before test. Apply the same candidate as for local serving. For deployment, at least 44 of 48 authored differences must give both exact values, with no findings on constructed confounds and no unexplained control flags. Do not use these observations for AI-authorship confidence.
method.evidence: Require complete sentences in separate source blocks, identical normalized wording, punctuation, unit, qualifiers, citations and numeric values except one percentage numeral. Both exact Unicode locations must match the annotated changed delivery when triggered.
method.sample: 24 previously unused GAO test reports in salted source order, with an eligible percentage sentence in a complete highlight, and 128 additional unused reports with no sentence filtering.
